description: Read a message hidden in a PNG by the S3eidat Stego Image website or crypto_stego_hide (decrypting it if a password was used). Reports when there is no message, e.g. because the image was recompressed (JPEG), resized or edited. Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/stego-image/

image.description: The image with a hidden message (PNG): a local file path (absolute, or relative to the server's --root) or base64 data (raw or a data: URI).

password.description: Password, if the message is encrypted.

name: crypto_stego_reveal
title: Reveal a hidden message
